questions.question_text: Which essential hand tool is specifically used for watering delicate seedlings in a plant nursery without washing away the topsoil?
options: B) A watering can with a rose head
questions.answer: B) A watering can with a rose head

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank: In the tie and dye process, the parts of the cloth that are tightly tied with cotton thread resist the ________ and retain their original fabric color.
What is the primary vocational purpose of adding natural compost or organic manure to the soil while preparing a school habitat garden?
options: A) To drastically change the natural color of the soil
B) To make the soil hard and compact
C) To increase essential soil nutrients for healthy plant growth
D) To permanently eliminate all earthworms

sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of 'seed germination' in the practical context of starting a new plant nursery project. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Seed germination is the biological process where a dormant seed absorbs water, swells, and sprouts its first roots and shoots to grow into a new young seedling.

questions.question_text: Why is it highly recommended to plant native or local flowering plant species when designing a school habitat garden? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Native plants are naturally adapted to local climates. They require less maintenance, survive extreme weather better, and easily attract local beneficial insects like bees and butterflies.

questions.question_text: Describe the basic fabric folding technique used to create a linear striped pattern on a piece of cotton cloth before dyeing. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To create stripes, the fabric is folded tightly into long, straight pleats like an accordion. It is then bound firmly with string at regular intervals before dyeing.

questions.question_text: Your class is tasked with designing a small school habitat garden specifically to attract local birds and butterflies. Outline three practical steps you would take to ensure this garden project is a complete success. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: First, select a sunny location and prepare the soil with organic compost. Second, plant a diverse mix of nectar-rich native flowers of different heights. Finally, place shallow water bowls and hanging bird feeders to provide continuous hydration and food sources.
